title: Not the best but not the worse. Average.
text:
Not the best but not the worse. Average.. These AmazonBasics queen sized sheets are decent. They aren’t fantastic, but they aren’t awful either. They are just standard, middle of the road, average sheets. Perhaps it was because of the vivid description that I was expecting more. They are described as “organic sateen”, so I expected them to be luxurious and soft. These are more of a mid-grade set of sheets.

What I do like about these sheets: (1) The color. The mossy/sage color is soothing and perfect no matter the time of year. I think they also pair well with a variety of comforter/duvet covers, colors. (2) They fit my bed well. They don’t ride up or come off the corner of the mattress during the middle of the night. And (3) they wash well. And even if you forget to remove them immediately from the dryer and they have a few wrinkles, you can use a warm iron to smooth them up.

What I am still not sure about or sold on: (1) The feel of them. While these sheets are comfortable, they aren’t super soft. With that being said, while they aren’t as luxurious as I thought from the description, they do provide a decent night’s sleep.
